text:
maria: Quick sanity check — trying to onboard mosaic-lite-v2. We uploaded weights to gs://redwood-onboard/mosaic-lite-v2/weights.tar.gz but config-lint CI fails with a schema error: missing tokenizer.pad_token_id and it also flags context_window vs max_sequence_length mismatch. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex: I saw similar on a different model last week. Is tokenizer.json present next to weights (same bucket)? Sometimes tokenizer metadata is missing and our loader expects pad token explicitly.

maria: tokenizer.json is there but minimal. snippet from CI: 

```
SchemaError: missing required field "tokenizer.pad_token_id"
at validateField (config-lint)
expected fields: [model_name, weights.uri, tokenizer.pad_token_id, max_sequence_length]
found: [model_name, weights.uri, tokenizer.vocab_size, context_window]
```

maria: Note: upstream authors used "context_window":4096 instead of our canonical "max_sequence_length".

tzvika: That explains it. Our schema version (v3) has renamed the field. The validator currently treats context_window as an unknown field rather than an alias. We added aliasing in a patch but not rolled to prod.

sam: Quick options: 1) add alias support to the validator (safe) 2) patch the config.json in the bucket to include max_sequence_length + pad_token_id (fast) 3) add a temporary default in onboarding pipeline to infer pad_token_id=0 when missing (risky for some models).

maria: For this model we control authors — option 2 is fine. I can patch the config in the bucket now and re-run CI. Before I do, is there a preferred pad_token_id? The tokenizer reports special tokens: {"pad": "<pad>", "eos": "</s>"} but no numeric ids.

alex: If tokenizer.json contains the token to id map, prefer to set pad_token_id to that id. If not, using 0 is typical but confirm it doesn't collide with reserved ids in the vocab.

maria: tokenizer.json has "special_tokens": {"<pad>": "[PAD]"} but not helpful. I'll run a quick script to download tokenizer and map id.

config-lint-bot: CI check failed on branch onboarding/mosaic-lite-v2 (config-lint v2.4.1). Errors: missing required field tokenizer.pad_token_id; unknown field context_window. See https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

maria: I ran the script, pad_token_id is 1. Patch uploaded to gs://redwood-onboard/mosaic-lite-v2/config.json with max_sequence_length: 4096, tokenizer.pad_token_id: 1. Triggering config-lint again (PR #4872).

tzvika: Thanks. Long-term we should add a compatibility layer: accept context_window as alias for max_sequence_length and auto-fill tokenizer.pad_token_id when tokenizer provides explicit mapping. Filed infra task: INF-892 (aliasing + smart defaults).

sam: For the quick path can we add a lightweight validator fallback: if tokenizer present and pad missing, set pad_token_id to tokenizer.special_tokens["<pad>"] id and log a warning? That avoids silent bad defaults.

maria: Agreed. For now PR #4872 will unblock onboarding. I'll monitor evals after serving smoke tests.

alex: :thumbsup: ping me if CI still complains, I can push the alias patch to staging.

maria: Will do. Thanks all — closing this thread once CI passes. :pray:
